Ordinary public HTTPS fetch of the portal timed out, so its JavaScript/service endpoint and exact Jodhpur extent could not be traced; no parcel geometry query was made. Whether the specific WUP locator is covered by a Jodhpur urban Khasra layer or the state revenue BhuNaksha; whether either portal offers anonymous machine-readable vector geometry.
